name: The Origin
description: Where everything begins. A quiet point before the infinite.
detail: Every great journey begins with a single step. The Origin is the starting point of every possibility. Nothing is created without curiosity.

name: Blue Horizon
description: A distant world wrapped in light, mystery, and endless blue.
detail: Blue Horizon represents the unknown. Beyond every horizon lies something you have never seen, and beyond that, another horizon.

name: Silent Moon
description: A calm place in the middle of a universe that never stops moving.
detail: Silent Moon is a reminder that quiet moments are also part of the journey. Take time to observe, reflect, and find your direction.

name: Void
description: Beyond the stars, beyond the light. Something waits in the darkness.
detail: Void is not an ending. It is space for new ideas, new paths, and new discoveries waiting to take shape.

name: Eclipse
description: A rare moment when light and darkness become one.
detail: Eclipse represents change. Sometimes a different perspective is all it takes to reveal something extraordinary.

name: Infinity
description: No borders. No limits. Just the endless possibilities of what comes next.
detail: Infinity is the final world, but never the final destination. The universe is vast, and your curiosity can take you anywhere.
